summary: HawkEye 360 filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $125M senior secured revolving credit facility with Bank of America as administrative agent. The facility matures May 19, 2031, with interest at Term SOFR plus 2.25%-3.00% or base rate plus 1.25%-2.00%. Covenants include a maximum total net leverage ratio of 3.50x stepping to 3.00x. The facility is guaranteed by material domestic subsidiaries and secured by first-priority liens on substantially all assets. This is a routine credit facility agreement, not a special situation event.
